newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Netcom Nasdaq trade to begin this week.
newsitem.headline: Netcom Nasdaq trade to begin this week.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications company NetCom Systems AB said on Monday trading of its shares on the Nasdaq exchange would begin in the middle of this week after some technical formalities were completed.
NetCom was set up in 1993 to hold and manage the communications interests of Industriforvaltnings AB Kinnevik.

NetCom said in a statement all the necessary approvals had already been received from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and from the Nasdaq Stock Market for listing its B-series share on Nasdaq.
NetCom was trading four crowns higher at 118 crowns at 1140 GMT.
